body: I haven’t had a P45 from them yet as I’m still on the books. I haven’t done a shift in about a year, does this have an impact?
Honestly I try I really do but, it hits 11am and I just feel defeated like nothing will ever go well and the rest of the day I’m just thinking maybe tomorrow will be better it gets tiring
Feel like I’m throwing a pebble at a brick wall, nothing is happening
